request.style: English, male tenor solo with choir, strings, harp, organ, timpani, woodwinds, solemn, majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Nothing is unclean in itself
Convinced in the Lord Jesus
But if one regards it unclean
Then for that person it is unclean

[Pre-Chorus]
Do not let your food destroy
Someone for whom Christ died
Your good must not be spoken of
As evil in the eye

[Chorus]
For the kingdom of God
Is not eating and drinking
But righteousness and peace
And joy in the Holy Spirit

[Verse]
Who serves Christ in this way
Is pleasing to God
Approved by the people
Walking in the truth

[Pre-Chorus]
Let us pursue what makes
For peace and building up
Do not tear down the work
Of God for the sake of food

[Chorus]
For the kingdom of God
Is not eating and drinking
But righteousness and peace
And joy in the Holy Spirit

[Bridge]
Everything is clean indeed
But stumbling others is wrong
It is good to refrain
From meat and wine

[Outro]
Righteousness and peace
Joy in the Spirit
The kingdom of God
